concerns.text: T002b defines `SENSITIVITY_THRESHOLDS` as a 'range of low, moderate, and high values' rather than the explicit spec-mandated set {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} Å² required by FR-006. This is a semantic weakening of the functional requirement, as the task allows arbitrary values instead of the fixed set.

T015b calculates SASA and 3D descriptors (radius of gyration, principal moments, sasa_components) but omits 'Volume' and 'Shape Indices' explicitly required by Plan.md Phase 3 Step 5 and Spec FR-004 for the Geometry-Based Baseline. This creates a feature mismatch where the baseline (T021c) cannot be trained on the required feature set.

T015a implements a 're-sampling' attempt before halting when conformer failure rate > 10%. The Spec (Edge Cases) and Plan (Risk Management) mandate an immediate halt or bias analysis upon exceeding this threshold to prevent training on biased data. The re-sampling logic introduces a non-deterministic step not authorized by the spec, violating the 'halt' constraint.

T029 restricts multiple-comparison correction (Bonferroni/FDR) only to the McNemar's tests from T028, explicitly excluding the paired t-test from T025. FR-007 requires correction when 'multiple hypothesis tests are performed'. If T028 tests multiple thresholds on the same dataset as T025, the total family of tests requires correction, not just the McNemar subset. This is a semantic weakening of FR-007.

T028 relies on `SENSITIVITY_THRESHOLDS` from T002b (which is incorrectly defined as a generic range) rather than hard-coding the spec-mandated values {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} Å². This creates a dependency on a weakened configuration, risking unverified thresholds and violating FR-006.
